RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

The panel’s gender composition alone is not evidence of unlawful bias. In civil service appointments, selection panels are typically bound by structured competency frameworks and objective scoring rubrics. The successful candidate holds relevant postgraduate qualifications and specific international project leadership experience that may have aligned more closely with the role’s current priorities.

Alleging bias solely because the panel comprised four women lacks evidentiary support and would likely damage your professional reputation within the ministry. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your request for written feedback. Use that feedback to identify how your interview responses or competency examples were scored and where you can strengthen future applications.
